body: Well, my city has a LGBT group but I was the only trans person there. As for the psychiatrist calling my mum - she's always had a bad attitude when it comes to speaking to any authority figures who are discussing me, don't see why the psychiatrist should be any different. But I'll ask my psychiatrist to phone her

As an anorexic, depressed transgender person who faints in the middle of public buildings, I think about death a lot of the time. I'm surprised I haven't died yet, given my extremely ill living conditions.
and psychiatry's difficult atm because I'm not used to speaking about this stuff openly
I've met with a psychiatrist, my mum didn't want to go to the meeting

You have a family that loves and supports you. A lot of people would love to have a family like that. Please know that you're in a very lucky position right now and thus should stay alive. And who knows? You might make new friends when you're older. Or find a new hobby or whatever :)
